items.name: HatredForStickDrift
items.description:
HatredForStickDrift


Turn with buttons instead of your joystick, so stick drift can’t spin you around any more.




If your thumbstick drifts, you know the pain: you’re standing still and your gorilla slowly rotates on its own. HatredForStickDrift turns off joystick turning and lets you turn with the buttons you choose.




Features




Turn with any buttons: pick one button to turn left and one to turn right. They can be on the same controller or on different ones.

Rebind in game: click a binding, press the button you want, done.

Smooth or snap turning: smooth turning with adjustable speed (30–360°/s), or snap turning with an adjustable angle (15–90°).

Joystick turning off: the game’s own joystick turning is blocked while the mod is on, so drift can’t rotate you.

Floating glass menu: a clean, modern frosted-glass settings panel that floats in front of you and turns with you. Point a controller at it and pull the trigger to use it. Settings are saved between sessions.

Built for any VR controller: Quest, Rift / Rift S, Index, Vive and WMR controllers should all work.

Controls

Action How

Open / close menu Hold a joystick click and pull a trigger

Backup way to open it Hold B + Y for one second

Use the menu Point at it and pull the trigger

Default turning X turns left, A turns right Installation

Install BepInEx 5 (x64) for Gorilla Tag (MonkeModManager can do this for you).

Drop HatredForStickDrift.dll into Gorilla Tag\BepInEx\plugins.

Launch the game.

PC VR (Steam) only.




Notes If the joystick still turns you after a game update, set Turn to NONE on the in-game computer. Button turning keeps working. Please use mods responsibly. Only use mods in modded lobbies or private rooms where everyone is okay with it. Using mods in public lobbies can get you banned.

This mod is not affiliated with or endorsed by Another Axiom.

items.name: Bark
items.description: Bark is a mod for the VR game Gorilla Tag. It allows the player to summon a 3D interface into the game that toggles various fun/useful mechanics on and off. Because it is only enabled in modded lobbies, this mod is safe to use online.

items.name: BingusNametags++
items.description:
BingusNametags++ is a simple, clean, but customizable nametag mod for Gorilla Tag. You can customize it to your needs with a very cool featureset:

- customize your own nametag with **bold** *italicized*, underlined, and colored text
- customize the font used by pasting a `.ttf` or `.otf` file into the data directory
- change visibility of certain items (such as platform/special user icons and the nametags themselves)
- change offset, scale, and visibility of nametags
- change where the nametag is visible (for example, show in VR but not on the PC monitor)

It's also open-source, free, and doesn't take up half of your screen.

items.name: MonkeFrames
items.description:
MonkeFrames is a keyframe-based camera animator loosely based on the Orion Drift spectator view that allows you to plan out camera movements with transitions for each property.

Create a keyframe by pressing V. It's properties will show up on the MonkeFrames panel in the top right. You can tweak its transitions, position, and rotation, or replace the currently selected keyframe by pressing X.

items.name: GorillaLibrary
items.description:
# GorillaLibrary

GorillaLibrary is a master library meant to aid mod developers in various factors all around the games codebase.

Some notable feature include:
- **Custom gamemodes:** GorillaLibrary includes an easy way for mod developers to create custom gamemodes, familiar to those who made them using Utilla, with backwards compatibility with Utilla.
- **Easy networking:** A new channel system that any mod developers can use to easily network specific things inside of their mods.
- **Custom wardrobes:** Easily add things such as custom cosmetics or anything related to the wardrobes inside of the game in mods.
- **Easy game events:** GorillaLibrary provides a whole lot of events to subscribe to within your mods, these range from just the game initalizing to someone's colour changing.
- And a whole lot more including inputs, rig utilities, etc.

You can view the documentation here: 
https://gorillatagmoddinghub.github.io/GorillaLibrary/index.html

items.name: BinxOS
items.description:
### Public Beta
This is a public beta for this mod. There may be bugs and issues, you can ping me on Discord <@sirkingbinx> for bug reports.

Usage tutorial: https://youtu.be/IXQr4Ps9y0M

### BinxOS
BinxOS is an in-game dashboard and general utility for Gorilla Tag that allows media controls, window docking, reporting, and mod management. If you're tired of having to deal with many different tools to achieve what you want in Gorilla Tag, this is what you're looking for.

- Leaderboard: You can mute/unmute, report players, and view player and lobby information using an always-avaliable window.
- Windows: Bring your apps from Windows 10/11 into Gorilla Tag with proper overlay management. You can dock a window to your HUD, undock it into the in-game space, and interact with them.

items.name: Hands Free
items.description:
# Hands Free
Hands Free is a BepInEx mod for the steam version of gorilla tag. (SteamVR only!) The mod is meant to let your hands be free while in your steam menu.\
*the mod was originally going to be called Better Steam Menu (why the files have that name)*
## Config
This mod uses BepInEx built in config system.\
Head to your Gorilla Tag installation folder,\
`Gorilla Tag > BepInEx > config > com.lolcaf.handsfree.cfg`\
There is only one setting, you can toggle whether or not Hands Free will affect the meta report menu and free your hands while the menu is open.
